domain: saying hello and how the day is going

turns.text: Hi! How has your day been so far?
Quite good, thank you. I got through most of my list before lunch, which rarely happens.
That is a nice feeling. Mine has been slow, but I am not complaining.
A slow day can be a good thing. I hope the rest of it stays calm for you.
Do you have anything planned for the weekend?
Nothing big. I would like to visit the market on Saturday morning and then keep the rest free.
That sounds pleasant. I am helping a friend move, so mine will be less relaxing.
That is kind of you. I hope there are not too many stairs involved.
Third floor and no lift, unfortunately.
Oh dear. In that case I hope your friend is at least buying dinner afterwards.
It has been raining here since Monday. Is it any better where you are?
A little. We had some sun this morning, but the clouds came back by noon.
I would take a few hours of sun at this point.
I understand. A week of rain does make everything feel a bit grey.

domain: what to cook for dinner tonight

turns.text: I have no idea what to make for dinner tonight. Any suggestions?
What do you have at home? It is easier to start from there.
Some eggs, a few potatoes, an onion and half a pepper.
That is enough for a Spanish-style omelette. Fry the potatoes and onion slowly, then add the eggs.
I have never made one. Is it difficult?
Not really. The only tricky part is turning it over, and a plate helps with that.
I will give it a try. Thank you!
You are welcome. I hope it turns out well.
I have been sleeping badly this week. Do you have any advice?
Going to bed at the same time each night helps many people. Do you keep regular hours?
Not really. Some nights it is ten, other nights well past midnight.
That could be part of it. You could also try putting your phone away half an hour before bed.
The phone will be the hard part, but I will try it.
It is hard for most of us. Even a few nights should show whether it makes a difference.
I have just finished a book and I do not know what to read next.
What was the last one, and did you enjoy it?
A detective novel set in Edinburgh. I liked it a lot.
Then you might enjoy another crime series with a strong sense of place. Would you like something lighter or darker?
Lighter, I think. The last one was quite grim.
In that case, a classic Agatha Christie could be a good change. They are clever without being heavy.
I would like to go away for a weekend next month, but I cannot decide where.
Would you prefer a city, or somewhere quiet in the countryside?
Somewhere quiet, I think. Work has been busy.
Then I would look for a small town near a lake or the coast, within two or three hours of home.
That is a good point. I do not want to spend half the weekend travelling.
Exactly. A short journey leaves you more time to actually rest.

domain: houseplants that are hard to kill

turns.text: I keep forgetting to water my plants. Is there anything that can survive me?
A snake plant would be a good choice. It copes well with little water and not much light.
That sounds like my kind of plant. How often does it need watering?
Every two or three weeks is usually enough. It is more likely to suffer from too much water than too little.
I am thinking about learning to code, but I do not know where to start.
Many people begin with Python, because it reads quite clearly. Do you have something you would like to build?
I would like to automate some of the spreadsheets I use at work.
That is a very good first goal. Having a real task makes it much easier to keep going.
How long does it take to get anywhere?
I am not sure for everyone, but a few weeks of regular practice is often enough for small, useful scripts.
My daughter asked me why the sky is blue, and I realised I did not know.
It is because of how sunlight scatters in the air. Blue light is scattered much more than red light.
So the blue comes from all directions, not only from the sun?
Yes, exactly. That is why the whole sky looks blue during the day.
